context.goal: Recover this referral and establish a valid appointment within its stated scheduling constraints. If observations establish a declared human-only barrier that prevents this goal, create an evidence-supported human handoff under the public escalation policy; budget exhaustion alone does not justify escalation.

public_policy.allowed_recipient_semantics: Every listed recipient requires a receipt for the current matching report before closure.
public_policy.booking: A booking requires current provider eligibility, complete accepted packet and current matching authorization when required.
public_policy.encounter_context: For pre-visit recovery, encounter-linked supporting documents represent pre-visit workup associated with the planned specialist encounter; a final supporting document does not imply that the specialist visit has occurred. Encounter linkage requires document.encounter_id == referral.encounter_id. Referral linkage requires referral.referral_id in document.related_referral_ids. Patient, availability, type and status checks also apply. Post-visit consultation reports remain tied to the completed specialist encounter and appointment.
public_policy.escalation: Escalate only when observations establish a declared human-only barrier; budget exhaustion alone is not evidence.

escalation_evidence_contract.attempts: attempted_action_event_ids may be empty when reads already establish the barrier. Do not manufacture failed mutations. If supplied, IDs must refer to actual mutation calls preceding ticket creation; they do not substitute for required read evidence.

barriers.condition_and_reads: At least one eligible provider exists, but no eligible provider can receive a complete qualifying packet from the available document catalog. Read get_documents for the referral and get_provider_requirements for every eligible provider.

At least one eligible provider exists. Every eligible route requires authorization and has an appeal-only denial matching current coverage, with no currently valid approval permitting recovery. Read check_authorization for the referral; changing providers alone does not resolve this barrier.
At least one eligible provider exists. Read find_appointment_slots for every eligible provider; no available future slot satisfies the public scheduling constraints.
No provider in the complete candidate directory is eligible for this referral.

The specialist encounter is completed and no available current final report matches the target patient, encounter, referral and completed appointment. Read the complete consultation-report collection for the referral. An invalid candidate alone is insufficient.

escalation_evidence_contract.catalog_checks: For each directory-based barrier below, cite find_providers(referral_id) for the complete candidate set, and check_provider_eligibility(referral_id, provider_id) for EVERY returned candidate, including ineligible candidates. Directory results alone do not replace individual eligibility checks. Then perform category-specific reads for every eligible provider.
escalation_evidence_contract.evidence: Cite observation_event_id values from successful actual read responses in evidence_event_ids. All cited IDs must exist in this run and precede ticket creation. Tool names alone, failed reads, inferred absence and fabricated IDs are insufficient. Cite complete results, not only a selected record.
escalation_evidence_contract.freshness: Evidence must describe the current state when the handoff is graded. Directory membership, eligibility facts, provider requirements and the complete relevant document, authorization, report or available-future-slot collections must still match. Derived attached/currently_valid display fields are not compared as stored records. After a change establishes a barrier, obtain a fresh set of all required reads for that barrier, including directory and eligibility checks even for unchanged candidates. Do not reuse pre-change evidence alone. If later actions or time change those facts before grading, refresh evidence; reads themselves advance simulated time.
escalation_evidence_contract.handoff: Supply the supported blocker_code and its mapped human_action_code below, nonempty factual reason_unable_to_proceed and required_human_action text, plus evidence_event_ids and attempted_action_event_ids. A tool accepting the ticket is not a guarantee of benchmark success.
escalation_evidence_contract.scope: Shared evaluation-task handoff contract. This table does not identify the outcome of any task. Ordinary blockers such as missing_required_document, unsubmitted_complete_packet or report_delivery_failed do not by themselves justify a terminal handoff. The barrier must actually prevent the requested goal.

public_policy.failed_reads: A failed read establishes unknown state, not an unavailable resource or a human-only barrier.

tools.name: get_referral
tools.description: Inspect referral records, linked IDs, and public scheduling/delivery policies.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Read authoritative coverage and source-versioned records.

tools.name: get_documents
tools.description: List discoverable document metadata and attachment status.

tools.name: get_provider_requirements
tools.description: Read current provider documentation and authorization requirements.

tools.name: find_providers
tools.description: List directory candidates for the authorized specialty; check eligibility separately.

tools.name: check_provider_eligibility
tools.description: Check network, specialty, and intake eligibility.

tools.name: check_authorization
tools.description: Inspect authorization records and current applicability.

tools.name: find_appointment_slots
tools.description: List available provider slots and patient constraints.

tools.name: get_appointments
tools.description: Inspect linked appointments, including existing bookings.

tools.name: get_consultation_reports
tools.description: List report candidates with linkage, version, and status.

tools.name: get_report_delivery
tools.description: Inspect delivery status and receipt for a specific delivery.

tools.name: attach_document
tools.description: Attach an available qualifying document; duplicate attachment is a no-op.

tools.name: submit_referral
tools.description: Submit a complete packet for acceptance; rejection is a domain outcome.

tools.name: reroute_referral
tools.description: Change to an eligible provider; invalidates prior acceptance and provider authorization.

tools.name: request_authorization
tools.description: Request authorization; approved, denied, and pending are distinct outcomes.

tools.name: schedule_appointment
tools.description: Book a compliant slot after acceptance and required authorization.

tools.name: reconcile_appointment
tools.description: Link an existing valid appointment without creating a duplicate.

tools.name: deliver_report
tools.description: Deliver a current matching final report to an authorized recipient; does not close.

tools.name: close_referral
tools.description: Close only after completed visit and required current report receipts.

tools.name: escalate
tools.description: Record an evidence-linked human handoff. This does not certify that escalation is justified.
